title: unified-rollouts: canary + shadow auto-rollback enhancements
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Improve resilience and observability of unified rollouts when using combined canary + shadow traffic patterns. This PR implements additional safety guards for metric-driven auto-rollback, tightens quorum logic for quarantine metrics, and adds telemetry hooks to better diagnose false positives in production.

Scope:
- Extend the autorollback engine to support composite metric quorums across canary and shadow lanes.
- Add adaptive thresholding heuristics that reduce sensitivity for low-volume canaries.
- Emit detailed rollback decision traces to tracing and metrics so post-mortem analysis is straightforward.
- Add end-to-end tests that simulate shadow probing failures and ensure rollback triggers and quarantines work as expected.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (ENG-4173)
- [x] Unit tests for quorum/threshold logic
- [x] E2E tests for canary+shadow scenarios
- [x] Metrics + tracing added
- [x] Documentation updates

Notes: This is an additive, backwards-compatible change. Existing rollout configs continue to behave the same unless a user opts into the new composite_quorum and adaptive_threshold flags. See docs/rollouts/autorollback.md for configuration details and examples.

release_notes:
- Add composite_quorum option to autorollback engine for combining metrics across canary and shadow lanes.
- Adaptive thresholds to lower false positives for low-volume canaries.
- New metrics: rollout.rollback_decision.initiated, rollout.rollback_decision.overridden.
- Improved tracing for rollback decisions to aid post-mortems.
- E2E tests covering canary+shadow rollback and quarantine flows.
